rationale: Deliberate +15.2 KB gzip against the 2026-07-16 baseline (371339 -> 386556), well inside the 450000 ceiling. Attributable to shipped user-facing behaviour: dark-mode pre-paint and theme toggle, cart live regions and unavailable-line handling, PDP quantity selector and add-to-cart pending state, breadcrumb trail, collection results announcer, infinite-scroll retry, and the added route error boundaries. The largest chunk and total CSS both went down. The /styleguide route is development-only and is not part of this measurement.
